instrumentationUsed.note: 임시 콘솔 타임스탬프 계측을 src/actions/delivery.ts, src/app/(protected)/delivery/page.tsx, src/components/delivery/delivery-board.tsx에 추가해 실측 후 전부 원복(git diff 결과 3개 파일 변경 없음 확인)

rootCause.buggyPattern: page.locator(...).textContent() has Playwright's default ~30s actionTimeout auto-wait when 0 elements match, before falling through to .catch()
rootCause.affectedHelper: draftCountText() — identical implementation duplicated across 4 QA scripts since STEP11-13
rootCause.impact: Every 'draft indicator disappeared' check after a successful save silently waited out the full ~30s Playwright timeout, producing a flat ~30-34s 'save time' regardless of actual batch size or actual server/DOM completion time (~1-1.5s)
rootCause.verification: Same scenario re-measured with .count() (no auto-wait) instead of .textContent() — settle time dropped to 1.0-1.2s, matching independently-measured server+client timings

retraction.retractedClaim: 5건과 150건 저장이 배치 크기와 무관하게 ~30-34초 고정비용을 가진다는 STEP12-2의 Section H 결론
retraction.reason: QA measurement bug (see rootCause above), not a real app performance characteristic
